record.paper_title: Some open problems on excluding a uniform matroid
record.context_brief: Incompatible projective-geometry minors over different characteristics
record.original_question: For finite fields F1 and F2 of different characteristic and every positive integer k, does there exist an integer n such that any matroid M with two n-interconnected minors PG(n,F1) and PG(n,F2) must contain a U_{k,2k}-minor? Two minors N1 and N2 are k-interconnected in M when every separation (X,Y) of N1 from N2 satisfies r_M(X)+r_M(Y)-r(M) at least k.

evidence.quote: We say that N1 and N2 are k-interconnected in M if for each pair (X, Y ) separating N1 from N2, we have rM (X) + rM (Y ) − r(M) ≥ k.

Conjecture 9.1. Let F1 and F2 be finite fields of different characteristic and let k be a positive integer. Then there is an integer n such that, if M is a matroid with two n-interconnected minors PG(n,F1) and PG(n,F2), then M contains a Uk,2k-minor.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let M be a matroid with ground set E(M), rank function r_M, and total rank r(M). Recall that for a minor N of M, a separation of N (with ground set E(N)) is a partition (X,Y) of E(M) such that E(N) ⊆ X ∪ Y in a way compatible with the contraction/deletion expressing N as a minor. Given two minors N_1 and N_2 of M, a pair (X,Y) is said to separate N_1 from N_2 if (X,Y) is a partition of E(M) with E(N_1) ⊆ X and E(N_2) ⊆ Y (up to the contraction/deletion identification). The minors N_1 and N_2 are said to be k-interconnected in M if for every such pair (X,Y) separating N_1 from N_2,
    r_M(X) + r_M(Y) − r(M) ≥ k.
For a prime power q, let PG(n, GF(q)) denote the rank-(n+1) projective geometry over the finite field GF(q), and let U_{k,2k} denote the uniform matroid of rank k on 2k elements.

Question: Let F_1 and F_2 be finite fields of different characteristic, and let k be a positive integer. Does there exist an integer n (depending on F_1, F_2, and k) such that every matroid M which contains two n-interconnected minors isomorphic to PG(n, F_1) and PG(n, F_2) must contain a U_{k,2k}-minor?
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of this conjecture was located. It appears in the matroid-minors structure-theory program (related to work of Geelen, Gerards, and Whittle) and is generally regarded as open; surveys of excluded uniform-minor problems list it among current open conjectures, with no announcement of a proof or counterexample.

status_evidence.title: Towards a matroid-minor structure theory
status_evidence.snippet: Structural conjectures about matroids with highly connected projective-geometry minors over different fields remain part of the ongoing program.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture sits within an active structural program with no resolution announced.

status_evidence.title: On minor-closed classes of matroids with exponential growth rate
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses excluding uniform matroids and projective-geometry minors over different characteristics in matroid classes.
status_evidence.claim: Related results exist but do not resolve the stated conjecture.
